rules.rule: Accepted/frozen R2 evidence remains valid historical evidence after R3 promotion and is not rewritten merely to change architecture_revision labels. It cannot authorize new post-promotion runtime work by itself.
R3 promotion is forbidden while an R2 runtime Work Order owns the runtime slot. Current canonical generation 78 records H0_1_PASS, C22 MAIN_INTEGRATED and H0.1 runtime slot RELEASED.

C22 MAIN_INTEGRATED authorizes only the fresh-main R3 repin/final verification sequence. NX.C1 remains blocked until canonical R3 promotion, mandatory post-R3 PC0, and fresh NX.C1 dispatch from then-current main.
Every runtime frontier created after canonical R3 promotion must start from then-current canonical main and declare the canonical R3 architecture revision.

Research/advisory branches may remain historical or research evidence without forced architecture relabeling. ECO never becomes economy, a game-runtime scheduler, or a mandatory foundation gate merely because R3 is promoted.

Stable accepted foundations remain canonical truth owners unless a named R3 intersection requires an adapter or contract extension. ITEM remains the stable canonical item foundation; R3 does not replace it by declaration.

V0 remains a composition/presentation/readback consumer and cannot promote its own domain truth. H0.3 is the DEVELOPMENT multi-worker Work-Order scheduler/control layer; it is not a game-runtime process scheduler, gameplay authority owner, simulation/game-time owner, or replacement for domain runtime scheduling.
ECO is evolutionary-ecology research/advisory. ECON is the reserved future economy program. Economy semantics must not reuse ECO ownership or identifiers.
Wave A branches may be created only after GLOBAL_ARCHITECTURE_PROMOTION and must all branch from one accepted canonical R3 main base or a later explicitly audited descendant.

Promotion must be a control/docs/config change with no gameplay/runtime mutation, must update canonical architecture identity consistently, must pass standard and directional PC0 NON_RED, and requires explicit human GLOBAL_ARCHITECTURE_PROMOTION authorization.

Stale SHA, stale registry generation, branch-local state and historical evidence are provenance only. None can authorize R3 promotion or new runtime work. Fresh current-main and canonical-registry facts must be recaptured at the promotion epoch.
